comment: Skincare routine shown behind the Skincare chip. Steps run in the order listed, which is the order they go on: thin water-based serums first, anything oil- or squalane-based after them, cream last. Keep notes to one short line — the panel is built to fit a phone screen without scrolling. Each step needs a name; note and when are optional. 'when' can be omitted for daily, or a comma-separated list of German weekday abbreviations (Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So). Editing this file is enough; no rebuild.
